title: Delhi to Varanasi Bus During Chhath Puja: Route Guide
summary: Everything you need for a Delhi to Varanasi bus during Chhath Puja: route, fares, journey time, festive booking window and how to reach the ghats.
body_markdown:
The 794 kilometres between Delhi and Varanasi turn into a different kind of journey during Chhath. Every year, in the week before Kartik Shukla Shashthi, the same buses that run this corridor become the only reliable option for lakhs of Purvanchali families whose train tickets never confirmed. Understanding how this route works during the festive rush is the difference between reaching Varanasi in time for the Sandhya Arghya and not travelling at all.


## **What This Route Guide Covers**


This guide covers the Delhi to Varanasi bus during Chhath Puja: the actual route and distance, the journey time, the fare pattern in the festive window, and the timing sequence that gets you to the ghat side of the city by mid Saturday. It draws on the current live route data rather than general estimates.


Everything below assumes an overnight departure and a morning arrival, which is how most of this corridor is operated. Live schedules and current fares sit on the[Delhi to Varanasi bus route page](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-varanasi-bus-route) , which is the reliable single source once you know your date.


# **Delhi to Varanasi Bus During Chhath Puja: Route, Timing and Booking**


Getting the timing of this route right is what defines a delhi to varanasi bus chhath puja trip. The bus needs to leave Delhi late enough to give the traveller a full night’s rest, and arrive early enough to allow the day to be spent on Kharna preparations. The sections below break down each part of the journey from that lens.


## **The Route: Delhi to Varanasi at a Glance**


The Delhi to Varanasi corridor covers approximately 794 kilometres by road, and the drive takes around 13 hours 15 minutes on the current schedule. The buses on this route depart Delhi in the late evening window, typically between 9:30 PM and 10:00 PM, and reach Varanasi in the mid morning of the next day.


The road passes through Uttar Pradesh via the Yamuna and Purvanchal expressways for much of the corridor, which is what keeps the timing this reasonable for a distance of this size. Two daily services currently operate the delhi to varanasi bus chhath puja route with zingbus, with fares that start around Rs 553 in the standard window and vary with demand.


## **Why Chhath Puja Changes This Route**


For eleven months of the year, the Delhi to Varanasi bus is one of many options. In the two weeks before Chhath, it becomes something else entirely. The train waiting lists on the Delhi to Varanasi corridor stretch into the hundreds for this window, and confirmed tatkal tickets disappear within minutes of opening.


The result is a compressed demand pattern where the same fixed capacity of overnight buses has to absorb travellers who would ordinarily be on trains. Fares rise as the festival approaches, seat availability shrinks, and the buses that leave on the Friday and Saturday before the Sandhya Arghya are booked out days in advance. This is not a rumour or an exaggeration. It is the pattern this route follows every year.


## **Departure Windows and Arrival Timing**


The late evening departures are shaped around the arrival needing to happen in Varanasi’s morning hours. A 9:30 PM bus out of Delhi typically reaches Varanasi by around 10:45 AM the next day, which gives most of the day for onward local movement to the ghat side of the city and any household prep.


For a Chhath week specifically, the ideal outbound is a departure on Friday, November 13, 2026, arriving in Varanasi on Saturday morning. That leaves the full Saturday for Kharna preparations, then Sunday for the fast and the Sandhya Arghya on Kartik Shukla Shashthi. Booking a Thursday night departure works too if you want a longer buffer, though the fares on the earlier date are usually lower than the Friday and Saturday peaks.


## **Fares in the Festive Season**


Regular fares on the Delhi to Varanasi bus corridor start around Rs 553 for a standard AC service and rise into the four figure range for premium options such as Volvo sleepers with additional amenities. Those are the everyday numbers.


In the Chhath window, expect fares to move upward across the board as demand builds, with the increase most visible on the peak dates of November 12 to 14. Booking well ahead protects both the seat and the price. Prices are approximate and may vary based on season, demand, and availability, and the current fare on your specific date is what the live listing shows rather than a general estimate.


## **The Journey Experience**


This is a 13 to 14 hour overnight, so the coach type matters more than on shorter routes. AC sleeper services are the most common configuration for this corridor, with two by one berth layouts that give you room to actually sleep rather than nap. Charging points and reading lights are standard, and select services on this route offer a pre bookable meal option, added at checkout.


On the safety side, the standard corridor features apply. GPS live tracking through the app, female friendly seating options, and a two driver rotation on this longer overnight route. On the Freemeal front, this corridor does not fall in the three named routes where the coupon applies, so plan a light meal at Delhi before boarding and expect a highway food stop somewhere through the night.


## **Arriving in Varanasi and Reaching the Ghats**


Buses arrive at various points around Varanasi, and the specific drop point matters if you are heading straight to a ghat. The main ghat belt, from Assi through Dashashwamedh to Manikarnika, is easiest reached from the central drop points. For the smaller ghats through Panchganga or Bhainsasur, a short auto ride from the arrival point is usually enough.


During Chhath, expect the roads near the ghats to be closed to vehicles from the afternoon of the Sandhya Arghya day through to the morning of the Usha Arghya. Plan the arrival for early enough on Saturday that you can complete any household movement before the closures begin. Beyond the festival itself, the[Varanasi places to visit guide](https://www.zingbus.com/blog/places-to-visit-in-varanasi-ghats-temples-street-food/) is useful if you plan a few extra days in the city.


## **Booking Approach for the Chhath Window**


For any delhi to varanasi bus chhath puja plan, the single most important step is to book both legs together. The return from Varanasi is where most travellers get caught out, because the demand pattern for the return leg peaks between Monday November 16 evening and Tuesday morning as the entire crowd tries to leave at once.


Booking a return departure on Tuesday night or Wednesday spreads you clear of the return rush and usually means better fare and comfort. If your work calendar allows even one extra day, use it on the return side rather than the outbound. The Delhi to Varanasi bus during Chhath Puja is a manageable trip when you plan both directions in one sitting, and a stressful one when you leave the return to the last minute.


## **Practical Notes Before You Board**


A few honest details help. Carry a valid government photo ID for the booking and the journey. Reach the boarding point at least 20 minutes before the scheduled departure, because the pickup windows on Delhi routes tighten in the festive week and buses do not wait past the slot.


Pack light. The overnight run is easier with a single soft bag rather than multiple pieces, and space at ghat side accommodation in Varanasi is limited during the festival. Confirm the boarding point precisely on your ticket, since a Delhi to Varanasi bus route often has multiple pickup options and choosing the one closest to you saves an hour of local movement.


## **Getting the Trip Right**


The Delhi to Varanasi bus during Chhath Puja is not a trip you improvise. It rewards planning the outbound and return together, booking the seats several weeks ahead, and treating the arrival timing as fixed by the ritual dates rather than optional.


Do that and the delhi to varanasi bus chhath puja corridor works well. Late evening departure from Delhi, morning arrival in Varanasi, Saturday for Kharna, Sunday for the Arghya, and a quieter Tuesday return. It is a repeatable formula, and the earlier you book, the more predictable each part of it becomes.


## **Delhi to Varanasi Bus During Chhath: Common Questions**


The questions below cover what travellers ask most about this route in the festive week.


### **How long does the Delhi to Varanasi bus journey take?**


The Delhi to Varanasi bus during Chhath Puja typically takes around 13 hours 15 minutes for the roughly 794 kilometre journey, running as an overnight service with morning arrival.


### **What is the distance from Delhi to Varanasi by road?**


The road distance from Delhi to Varanasi is approximately 794 km, with the current schedules built around a late evening departure and an arrival in Varanasi the next morning.


### **When should I book the Delhi to Varanasi bus for Chhath 2026?**


Book as early as September or early October 2026. Seats on this corridor tighten sharply in the two weeks before Chhath, and fares are noticeably lower earlier.


### **What are the delhi to varanasi bus chhath puja fares?**


Fares start around Rs 553 for a standard AC service in normal conditions and rise with demand through the Chhath week. Check the live route page for your specific date.


### **Which day should I travel from Delhi to Varanasi for Chhath?**


Aim for a Friday, November 13 evening departure to arrive Saturday morning. That gives a full day for Kharna prep before Sunday’s Sandhya Arghya on Kartik Shukla Shashthi.


### **Are there overnight sleeper buses on this route?**


Yes, most services on this corridor are AC sleepers with two by one berth layouts, since the 13 to 14 hour overnight run is best done with a proper flat sleeping option.


### **How do I reach the Varanasi ghats after arriving by bus?**


Take a short auto or cab from your arrival point to the ghat side of the city. Expect road closures near the ghats from Sunday afternoon through Monday morning during Chhath.


### **Is there a meal service on the Delhi to Varanasi bus?**


Select services on this route offer a pre bookable meal added at checkout. This corridor is not one of the three named routes where the Freemeal coupon applies.


### **How many buses run daily on Delhi to Varanasi?**


Two daily services currently run on this zingbus route, with departures in the late evening window between 9:30 PM and 10:00 PM. Additional operators run separately.


### **Are the buses safe for women travellers?**


Yes, standard safety features on this corridor include GPS live tracking, female friendly seating options, and a two driver rotation on the longer overnight run.


### **When should I plan the return from Varanasi?**


Plan the return for Tuesday November 17 evening or later, since Monday night is the peak return rush after the Usha Arghya. A day later means better seats and calmer travel.


### **What should I carry for the overnight Delhi to Varanasi bus?**


Carry a valid government photo ID, a warm layer for the AC coach, a power bank, and a small snack for the highway break. Pack light for easier onward movement in Varanasi.
